import json, random, subprocess, sys, time
rng = random.Random(7)
n = 96
# layered core: source 0, 7 middle layers x3 (nodes 1..21), dest 22
edges=[]
def e(u,v,lab): edges.append({"u":u,"v":v,"ping_us":rng.randint(1,50),"ack_us":rng.randint(1,50),"label":lab})
for k in range(3): e(0,1+k,"a%d"%k)
for L in range(7):
    b=1+L*3; nx=1+(L+1)*3
    if L==6: nx=22
    for a in range(3):
        for b2 in range(3): e(b+a,nx+b2,"L%d_%d%d"%(L,a,b2))
# filler nodes 23..95 with edges among themselves (cannot join any s-t path)
pairs=[(u,v) for u in range(23,96) for v in range(u+1,96)]
rng.shuffle(pairs)
for (u,v) in pairs[:384-len(edges)]:
    e(u,v,"z%d_%d"%(u,v))
print("edges",len(edges),"nodes",n)
out=[[] for _ in range(n)]
for i,ed in enumerate(edges): out[ed["u"]].append(i)
cnt=[0]*n; cnt[n-1]=1
for v in range(n-2,-1,-1): cnt[v]=sum(cnt[edges[i]["v"]] for i in out[v])
print("paths",cnt[0])
rounds=[]
m=len(edges)
for i in range(48):
    proofish = sorted(rng.sample(range(23,m), 20))  # proofs that match no path
    rounds.append({"launch_us":i*11,"timeout_us":30,"host_delay_us":5,
                   "drop_host_ack":False,"drop_ping":[],"drop_ack":proofish})
obj={"version":1,"n":n,"capacity":[3]*n,"edges":edges,"rounds":rounds}
data=json.dumps(obj).encode()
t0=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","submission/main.py"],input=data,capture_output=True)
dt=time.time()-t0
print("rc",p.returncode,"time %.2fs"%dt,"outlen",len(p.stdout))
d=json.loads(p.stdout)
print("summary",json.dumps(d["summary"],separators=(",",":")))
print("metrics",json.dumps(d["metrics"],separators=(",",":")))

# now make every round observe everything (full proof) to stress the matching path
rounds2=[]
for i in range(48):
    rounds2.append({"launch_us":i*11,"timeout_us":400,"host_delay_us":5,
                    "drop_host_ack":False,"drop_ping":[],"drop_ack":[]})
obj2=dict(obj); obj2["rounds"]=rounds2; obj2["capacity"]=[48]*n
t0=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","submission/main.py"],input=json.dumps(obj2).encode(),capture_output=True)
print("rc",p.returncode,"time %.2fs"%(time.time()-t0),"outlen",len(p.stdout))
d=json.loads(p.stdout)
print("summary",json.dumps(d["summary"],separators=(",",":")))
print("metrics",json.dumps(d["metrics"],separators=(",",":")))
PYEOF
